title: Τhe risk of renewed inflation
summary:
Main
By Michalis Voutsinas
Two years ago this week, the Fed commanded global attention by cutting interest rates for the first time in four years, delivering a bold 50 basis point reduction that brought target range down to 4.75-5.00 percent. At the time, the move was framed as a balancing act - an attempt to nurture economic recovery while inflation remained above target. Markets welcomed the signal with enthusiasm: Wall Street surged to record highs.
